fields.label: Heartbeat Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: A Monitored Host is flagged unreachable once its agent hasn't pushed a payload for this long. Should be roughly 3x the agent's own push interval, not 1x, to tolerate a single missed push.

fields.label: Confirmation Checks
fields.description: Consecutive polls a service/worker condition must stay bad, with no dip, before an alert fires. Same semantics as Proxmox Monitor Settings.

fields.label: Scheduler Heartbeat Timeout (minutes)
fields.description: A bench's Frappe scheduler is flagged stalled if no Scheduled Job has executed within this window.

fields.label: Orphan Worker Warning Threshold
fields.description: Orphaned RQ worker registrations (present in Redis, no live PID) at/above this count colors the dashboard tile as a warning — dashboard display only, there is no separate "Worker Warning" alert type. See Critical Threshold below for what actually alerts.

fields.label: Orphan Worker Critical Threshold
fields.description: At/above this count, held for Confirmation Checks polls, raises the Worker Degraded alert.

fields.label: Failed Job Warning Threshold
fields.description: Open (unresolved) rows in Frappe Failed Job Log for a single bench at/above this count colors the dashboard tile as a warning — dashboard display only, there is no separate "Worker Warning" alert type. See Critical Threshold below for what actually alerts.

fields.label: Failed Job Critical Threshold
fields.description: At/above this count, held for Confirmation Checks polls, raises the Failed Job Threshold alert.

fields.label: Default Expected Services
fields.description: Baseline service list applied to every new Monitored Host (e.g. ssh, nginx, mariadb, redis-server). Override per-host on the Monitored Host record itself.
